title: kiosk-display-brightness
description: Payload for the kiosk display brightness topics. Published retained by the kiosk node to renewvan/kiosk/display/brightness (state), initialised from the live backlight sysfs reading (rescaled from the panel's native 0-31 range) on node startup; sent unretained by the dashboard to renewvan/kiosk/display/brightness/set (command). Normalized 0-100 so the wire contract doesn't depend on the attached panel's native brightness range.
